name: Eudonet Immobilier
positioning: A configurable French CRM with a real estate vertical — for organisations whose process does not fit an agency package.
description: Eudonet is a French CRM platform sold in vertical editions, including one for real estate professionals: contact and asset relationship management, prospect and mandate pipelines, campaign management, and configurable objects and workflows, hosted in France.
real_estate_use: It is chosen by organisations that are not classic agencies — institutional owners, developers, public bodies, networks — whose relationship processes do not match a transaction package. The configurability is the point: an object model for buildings, tenants, prospects and operations can be shaped to the organisation rather than the reverse, with French hosting satisfying public procurement requirements.
features: Configurable object model for assets, contacts and operations
Reporting and dashboards per business line
French hosting and public sector compliance

use_cases.job: Model relationships around assets and operations rather than around a sales pipeline
Track prospects and reservations on a development programme in a configurable CRM
